name: Police Car Town Chase 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Police Town Car Chase is an awesome fast-paced avoid game in which you must drive on a rampage through the town and try to avoid the police cars attempting to gun you down! You must drift around the map and avoid them at all costs - make sure you avoid the objects on the map as they can cause damage to you and even destroy your car.
